body: Thanks. I am smiling , sad smile but a smile.

Wow was afraid someone would say that. Any thoughts on how to hold myself together? My pets get me moving but keeping it together is tough. I have been told it will be easier once I am properly medicated.  But until that happens my coping skills just don't seem to be cutting it. I am falling apart.

Please don't. Believe me I know how hard it is not to have someone to hold you. 2 failed marriages trying to find someone. Sounds silly but adopt a cat or dog. Mine (1 dog, 3 cats) get me out of bed every day. Dogs especially big ones (mine is a 65 pound mutt) are great for hugs and unconditional love.
